usage.outputShape: body.url (final URL), body.title (page title), body.content (clean markdown of the page)
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {"url":"<page to scrape>"} to https://stableenrich.dev/api/firecrawl/scrape and pay the x402 quote (~$0.013 USDC, exact scheme, USDC on Base eip155:8453 or Solana). The response is a plain synchronous JSON object: read body.content for the page rendered as clean LLM-ready markdown, body.title for the page title, and body.url for the final URL after redirects. No auth, no polling, no template params.
